authority.official_program_provenance: EDSOO Federal Working Program Russian 5-9, 2025 / PUBLIC_OFFICIAL_PDF

decisions.boundary_guard: Identify the ending through inflection of the same word, distinguish a zero ending from absence of an ending in an indeclinable word, and derive the base only after that check; final letters alone do not prove an ending and this semantic does not grant word-formation or spelling mastery.

decisions.label_ru: Корень, приставка и суффикс: разбор по значению и родству
decisions.boundary_guard: Establish the root from modern semantic kinship plus formal recurrence, then test prefixes and suffixes through structural/derivational comparison; matching letter chunks or position alone are insufficient, and unsourced historical etymology is outside this bounded semantic.

decisions.label_ru: Чередование в морфемах и полный морфемный анализ
decisions.boundary_guard: Recognize alternation only after the identity and semantic relation of the morpheme are established, and perform full morphemic analysis through checked word forms and related words; not every graphic difference is an alternation and this does not independently grant orthographic or word-formation mastery.

explicit_non_acceptances.reason: The broad official domain establishes morphemics scope but does not prove one-to-one object binding for the three bounded components; object accounting remains unchanged.
Word-formation relations and formation methods remain a separate source-backed module and are not admitted through morphemics merely because the domains are prerequisites for one another.
Using morphemic structure as evidence for spelling does not by itself grant any exact orthographic semantic mastery.
No unsourced diachronic decomposition is admitted; the bounded learner semantics use current school morphemic analysis unless separate authority proves otherwise.
